notes.growth_5y_methodology: Calculated from total presentation-adjacent AI market growth: $0.89B (2021, Market Intelo) to $2.8B (2025) = +215% — but AI-NATIVE tools (Gamma, etc.) effectively went from $0 to $2.43B, making growth effectively infinite (+∞) for the pure AI-native segment. Reported as +∞ in trend data.
notes.growth_1y_methodology: Gamma ARR as category proxy: $30.5M (end 2024) → $100M (Nov 2025) = +228% YoY. This is the most reliable public figure for a pure-play AI presentation company.
notes.growth_3m_methodology: Estimated +68% based on: Q2 2026 product launches (Microsoft agentic Copilot for PowerPoint, Google Gemini full-deck GA), Canva AI 2.0 800M monthly AI tool uses (700% YoY), and Beautiful.ai March 2026 $45M financing. Exact 3M figure is [unverified] — directional estimate only.
notes.search_volume_methodology: Estimated ~300,000/mo across related queries: 'AI presentation', 'AI slides', 'AI PowerPoint', 'Gamma AI', 'AI presentation maker'. Not directly sourced from Keywords Everywhere — directional estimate based on Gamma's 70M users and 1M daily presentations.
